scripts.check: npm run -s typecheck && npm run -s test
scripts.cf:build: node scripts/cf-config.mjs create && opennextjs-cloudflare build; s=$?; node scripts/cf-config.mjs remove; exit $s
scripts.cf:preview: node scripts/cf-config.mjs create && opennextjs-cloudflare build && opennextjs-cloudflare preview; s=$?; node scripts/cf-config.mjs remove; exit $s
scripts.cf:deploy: node scripts/cf-config.mjs create && opennextjs-cloudflare build && opennextjs-cloudflare deploy; s=$?; node scripts/cf-config.mjs remove; exit $s
scripts.db:seed:remote: tsx scripts/export-seed.ts && wrangler d1 execute naf_academy --remote --file=.data/seed.sql
scripts.db:seed:local-d1: tsx scripts/export-seed.ts && wrangler d1 execute naf_academy --local --file=.data/seed.sql
